description: OVERLAYS group slice: Select, Picker, CommandPalette, PickerChain, Completion, Dialog, Menu, ContextMenu, MenuBar, HelpOverlay. Same stable IDs as v1/registry.json; ref_source lists reference source symbols verified present in the cited files. Cited files are identical between ref_commit and head_commit, so cited lines hold for both. CommandPalette is the Picker widget driven by jackin capsule; PickerChain is the jackin OpFlow account-vault-item-field chain; Menu is a MenuBar open dropdown while ContextMenu is the free anchored popover.
